note: Fixed UI strings (E4). Exempt from the claims gate; every other sentence comes from the lesson model.

strings.provenance: Captured from {compiler}, sandboxed, run twice · stdout sha256 {shas}
strings.explore_hint: Paused: explore the state on screen. Steps you have not watched yet stay hidden.
strings.noscript: Video controls need JavaScript. The frames and the full transcript are below.
strings.x_match: n = {n} matches case {k}, so control jumps to line {line}, the statement after that label.
strings.x_nomatch: n = {n} matches no case label and the switch has no default, so the switch body is skipped.
strings.x_fall: Case {a} has no break, so execution falls through into case {b} on line {line}.
strings.x_break: The break on line {line} ends the switch.
strings.x_end: Case {k} is the last case and has no break, so the switch ends at its closing brace on line {line}.
strings.x_captured: Captured run of {file} with n = {n} · stdout sha256 {sha}
strings.x_computed: Not a captured run: computed with the C17 switch rule. The captured runs set n to {n0}.
strings.x_noscript: The controls need JavaScript. Shown here: the captured run with n = {n0}, and a table of the output for every value the controls offer.
strings.x_table_caption: Output for each n. Only n = {n0} was captured; the other rows are computed with the C17 switch rule.
strings.qa_wrong: Not quite. That answer comes from a common wrong belief:
strings.qa_noscript: Without JavaScript every layer and the answer key are shown at once.
strings.card_md_intro: {count} cards from the lesson “{title}”. Every printed answer is a captured fact.
strings.ive_mode_film: Film: the panel shows what the video shows.
strings.ive_mode_explore: Exploring at {time}. The film is paused and your changes never alter it.
strings.ive_yours: Your edit, not in the film
strings.ive_locked: These controls unlock after the film answers its question, at {time}.
strings.ive_answers: Full transcript and frames, answers included.
strings.ive_no_data: The interactive panel could not load. The video and its controls still work.
strings.stack_steps: the call stack, step by step
strings.s_noscript: Without JavaScript every step is shown, in order.
strings.ive_step_back: An earlier step of the film, not the paused frame
strings.ive_ask_hint: The film waits here until you pick.
strings.ive_mode_ask: The film is waiting at {time} for your prediction.
strings.k_slot: empty slot: the call has not returned yet
strings.k_computed: Computed with the program's formula in double, in the program's order. Captured runs agree at {count} points.
strings.k_live: With w2 = {g_w2} and b = {g_b}, z prints as {g_z} and a prints as {g_a}.
strings.k_tiny: Here z prints as {g_z}, not 0: in binary64 (double), {g_x1} × {g_w1} is rounded to the nearest double, {d_t1}, so {g_x1} × {g_w1} + {g_x2} × w2 + b does not land exactly on 0.
strings.k_captured_point: This setting is a captured run: {file} printed these lines.
strings.qa_walk: A walkthrough step: read it when you are ready.
strings.mem_read_down: read from the highest address down
strings.stack_order: main on top · each call below its caller
